fixes: router/consumer锁改为os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY)原子创建, 消除TOCTOU竞态; 旧锁PID已死则接管
杀掉手动重复的WorkBuddy python舰队, 仅保留ORCA tui_gateway托管的单一舰队(VNPY python: 1 router + 2 consumer)
